questions.q: P's income is 150 percent of Q's income and P's expenditure is 60 percent of Q's expenditure. If Q saves 20 percent of his income, then how much percentage does P save of his own income?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ratio se khelna seekh! P aur Q ki Income ka ratio 150:100 yani 3:2 hai. Asani ke liye 300 aur 200 maan le. Q apni income (200) ka 20% bachata hai, yani Q ki saving = 40. Toh Q ka kharch (expenditure) kitna hua? 200 - 40 = 160. P ka kharch Q ke kharch ka 60% hai, matlab 160 ka 60% = 96. Ab P ki income 300 aur kharch 96 hai. P ki saving = 300 - 96 = 204. Saving percentage nikal: $\frac{204}{300} \times 100 = 68\%$. Bina x-y maane answer tumhari screen pe!

questions.q: The cost of packaging of the mangoes is 40% the cost of fresh mangoes themselves. The cost of mangoes increased by 30% but the cost of packaging decreases by 50%, then the percentage change of the cost of packed mangoes, if the cost of packed mangoes is equal to the sum of the cost of fresh mangoes and cost of packaging:
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Maan le fresh mangoes ki cost 100 hai, toh packaging 40 hogi. Total initial cost ho gayi 140. Nayi cost nikal: Mangoes 30% badh kar 130 ho gaye, aur packaging 50% ghat kar 20 bachi. Naya total = 130 + 20 = 150. Pehle total 140 tha, ab 150 hai. Increase hua 10 ka kis par? 140 par! $\frac{10}{140} = \frac{1}{14}$. Direct fraction yaad honi chahiye, $\frac{1}{14}$ matlab 7.14% hota hai!

questions.q: The strength of SSC Aspirants increases and decreases every alternate year. It starts with increase by 20% and thereafter the percentage of increase/decrease is the same. Which of the following is definitely true about the strength of SSC Aspirants in 2000 as compared to that in 1996?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 1996 se 2000 tak total 4 saal ka gap hai. Successive percentage lagana hai: +20%, -20%, +20%, -20%. Base 100 maan le. 100 $\times 1.2 \times 0.8 \times 1.2 \times 0.8 = 100 \times 0.96 \times 0.96$. 96 ka square nikalna bahut aasan hai (100 se 4 kam hai, toh 96-4=92 aur $4^2$=16) yani 0.9216! Toh final value ho gayi 92.16. 100 se 92.16 aane me decrease kitna hua? Seedha 7.84% ka decrease. Number dekhte hi logic set hona chahiye!

questions.q: In a school ratio of number of boys and girls is 16:9. 68.75% of boys and 44.44% of girls went for picnic. Find the percentage of total students who did not go to picnic?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, dangerous percentages ko fraction me tod le! 68.75% = 50% + 18.75% = $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{16} = \frac{11}{16}$. Aur 44.44% standard $\frac{4}{9}$ hai. Boys jo picnic gaye: 16 ka $\frac{11}{16}$ = 11. Jo nahi gaye = 16 - 11 = 5. Girls jo picnic gayi: 9 ka $\frac{4}{9}$ = 4. Jo nahi gayi = 9 - 4 = 5. Total log jo NAHI gaye = 5 + 5 = 10. Total students = 16 + 9 = 25. Toh 25 me se 10 nahi gaye, matlab $\frac{10}{25} \times 100 = 40\%$. Smart calculation hamesha time bachati hai!

questions.q: The average marks of the students in four subjects History, Biology, Chemistry and Physics together is 60%. The average marks of the students in History, Biology, Chemistry and Physics individually are 45%, 50%, 72% and 80% respectively. If the average marks of the students of History and Biology together is 48% and that of the students of Biology and Chemistry together is 60%. What is the ratio of number of students in History and Physics?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye double Alligation ka shandaar sawal hai! Pehle History (45) aur Biology (50) ko mix karke 48 la. Ratio aayega (50-48):(48-45) = 2:3. Fir Biology (50) aur Chemistry (72) ko mix karke 60 la. Ratio aayega (72-60):(60-50) = 12:10 yani 6:5. Ab in ratios ko merge kar. H:B = 4:6 aur B:C = 6:5. Toh H:B:C = 4:6:5. Inka common multiplier 'k' maan le. Total average sabka 60 hai. Deviation method laga: H(-15) x 4 + B(-10) x 6 + C(+12) x 5 + P(+20) x X = 0. (-60) + (-60) + (+60) + 20X = 0 $\implies$ 20X = 60 $\implies$ X = 3. Yani Physics ke bachhe 3 hain. History : Physics ka ratio 4:3 hoga!

questions.q: A manufacturer reduces the diameter of their spherical bearing balls by 50% to cut costs. What is the percentage decrease in volume of each ball?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Volume 3D hoti hai, isliye radius ya diameter ka change cube ($r^3$) me effect karta hai. Agar diameter 50% (yani $\frac{1}{2}$) kam hua hai, toh wo 2 se 1 ban gaya. Volume $2^3$ se $1^3$ banega, yani 8 se 1. Decrease kitna hua? 7 ka decrease 8 par. $\frac{7}{8}$ ki direct percentage value 87.5% hoti hai. Secondon me uda!

questions.q: In an election, there were four candidates and 95% of voters cast their votes. One candidate got 25% of the votes while the other three shared the remaining votes in the ratio of 6:7:2. The difference of votes secured by the candidate standing 3rd to the candidate standing 4th is equal to 69198. Find the votes secured by the winning candidate.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, dhyan se proportion set kar. Ek ko 25% mile, toh bache 75% ko 6:7:2 me baant. Ratio ka sum = 15 units. 15 units = 75% $\implies$ 1 unit = 5%. Toh baaki teeno ko mile 30%, 35%, aur 10%. Ranks dekh: 1st=35%, 2nd=30%, 3rd=25%, 4th=10%. 3rd aur 4th ka difference = 25% - 10% = 15%. Ye 15% barabar hai 69198 ke. Pucha hai winning candidate (35%) ke votes. $\frac{69198}{15} \times 35 = 69198 \times \frac{7}{3} = 23066 \times 7 = 161462$. Unit digit se bhi verify kar sakta tha, 6x7=42 last me 2 aayega, sirf ek option hai!

questions.q: A bacteria culture increases by 20% every hour for 3 hours, then decreases by 10% in the 4th hour, and finally increases by 25% in the 5th hour. If the initial count was 5,000, what will be the approximate count after 5 hours?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Successive line method laga de bina pen uthaye. 5000 $\times 1.2 \times 1.2 \times 1.2 \times 0.9 \times 1.25$. Calculation trick: $1.2 \times 1.25 = 1.5$ hota hai. Nayi line bani: 5000 $\times 1.44 \times 1.5 \times 0.9 = 5000 \times 2.16 \times 0.9 = 5000 \times 1.944 = 9720$. Exact match kar raha hai. 9 aur 5 ke multiples mix ho rahe hain, divisibility rule bhi check kar sakta hai!

questions.q: Marks: Eng 45/50; Maths 70/100; Sci 40/50; Hist 55/100. Approx cumulative percentage?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye basic data interpretation hai. Total marks obtained = 45 + 70 + 40 + 55 = 210. Maximum possible marks = 50 + 100 + 50 + 100 = 300. Overall percentage banegi $\frac{210}{300} \times 100 = 70\%$. Bacha question!

questions.q: A mixture containing 18% methanol is mixed with another mixture containing b% methanol in the ratio 4:5. If the percentage of methanol in the final mixture is 16%, what is the value of b?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Alligation lagao seedha! 18% aur b% ko mix kiya, final 16% bana. Ratio given hai 4:5. Alligation ki equation banegi: $\frac{18 - 16}{16 - b} = \frac{5}{4}$. Yani $\frac{2}{16 - b} = 1.25$. Cross multiply kar: $2 = 20 - 1.25b \implies 1.25b = 18$. Ab $b = \frac{18}{1.25} = 14.4\%$. Ekdum crystal clear concept!

questions.q: In an election, a candidate secures 42% of the votes polled but is defeated by his only opponent by a majority of 3080 votes, because of 1400 invalid votes. The percentage of invalid votes is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, maan le total polled votes 100x hain. Haarne wale ko 42x mile. Invalid votes 1400 hain. Toh valid votes hue $100x - 1400$. Jeetne wale ko mile: Valid - Haarne wale ke votes = $(100x - 1400) - 42x = 58x - 1400$. Ab margin (majority) nikalo: Jeetne wala - Haarne wala = $(58x - 1400) - 42x = 16x - 1400$. Ye margin hume 3080 diya hua hai. Toh $16x = 4480 \implies x = 280$. Total polled votes = 28000. Invalid ka percentage: $\frac{1400}{28000} \times 100 = 5\%$. Basic equation se sabse jaldi aata hai!

questions.q: Out of her total monthly income, a woman spends 60% on household expenses and 15% on savings. The remaining amount is spent on other items. What percentage of her income is spent on other items?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isme successive nahi diya hai, direct overall percentage ki baat kar raha hai! Total 100% maan. 60% household pe gaya, 15% saving pe gaya. Total gaya 75%. Bacha kitna? 100 - 75 = 25%. Yahi toh pucha tha ki bacha hua amount (other items) kitna hai. Exam pressure me aise sawal par lamba na sochna.

questions.q: A number was mistakenly increased by 25% instead of decreased by 20%. By what percent is the final result more than the correct value?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Number ko 100 maan le. Sahi karna kya tha? 20% ghata kar 80 laana tha. Gadhe ne kya kiya? 25% badha kar 125 laa diya. Mistake wala number sahi number se kitna bada hai? $125 - 80 = 45$ bada hai. Percentage error hamesha Sahi (correct) value par nikalte hain. Toh $\frac{45}{80} \times 100 = \frac{9}{16} \times 100 = 56.25\%$. Fractions yaad hone chahiye CGL ke liye!

questions.q: When (A + 10)% of a number is added to 180, the result is the same number. If 120% of the original number is 540, then find (A - 26)% of the original number.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, statement by statement crack kar! 120% number 540 ke barabar hai, yani $1.2N = 540 \implies N = 450$. Pehli statement keh rahi hai ki Number ka kuch hissa + 180 mila kar wapis Number ban jata hai. Matlab jo hissa bacha, wo exactly 180 hai. Pura number 100% hota hai. Agar (A+10)% me 180 add ho raha hai, matlab 180 us number ka $(100 - (A+10))\%$ hai. Toh $450 - 180 = 270$. Number ka (A+10)% part 270 hona chahiye. $\frac{270}{450} = \frac{3}{5} = 60\%$. Toh $A+10 = 60 \implies A = 50$. Pucha hai (A-26)% of N, yani 24% of 450. Result aaya 108. Dimag ko tez daudao!

questions.q: In an election between two candidates, y% of the voters did not vote. 10% of the votes cast were declared invalid, while all the valid votes were cast in favour of either of the two candidates. The candidate who got 59.375% of the valid votes cast was declared elected by 2484 votes. If the number of people eligible to vote in that election was 16,000, what is the value of y?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, back-tracking se isko makhan ki tarah hal karenge. Winner ko 59.375% mile toh loser ko 100 - 59.375 = 40.625% mile. Margin aya $18.75\% = \frac{3}{16}$. Ye fraction barabar hai 2484 ke. Toh total Valid votes honge $2484 \times \frac{16}{3} = 13248$. Ab Valid votes 90% the (kyunki 10% invalid hue). Toh Casted votes honge $\frac{13248}{0.9} = 14720$. Eligible 16000 the, cast 14720 ne kiye. Kitno ne vote nahi diya? 1280 logo ne. Percentage y = $\frac{1280}{16000} \times 100 = 8\%$. Reverse engineering OP!

questions.q: A’s salary is 120% of B’s salary and B spends 60% of his salary for house rent and education fees. If B’s savings is Rs. 1800 and A’s expenditure is 40% more than that of B, then what is the saving amount of A?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, base values pakdo. B ka kharch 60% hai toh bachat (saving) 40% hui. 40% = 1800 de rakha hai, iska matlab B ki total salary = 4500. Ab A ki salary B ka 120% hai, yani A = $4500 \times 1.2 = 5400$. B ka kharch (60%) kitna tha? 2700. A ka kharch is se 40% jyada hai, yani $2700 \times 1.4 = 3780$. A ki saving = Income - Expenditure = $5400 - 3780 = 1620$. Asaan flow follow kar, calculation errors nahi hongi.

questions.q: After three successive raises, Aftab's salary became equal to $\frac{378}{125}$ times of his initial salary. By what percentage was the salary raised the first time if the third raise was twice as high (in percentage) as the second raise and the second raise was twice as high (in percentage) as the first raise?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, variable se mat solve kar warna fass jayega. Options elimination is the ultimate key yaha par! $\frac{378}{125} = 3.024$ multiplier hai. Options check kar. Agar 1st raise 20% hai, toh dusra 40% aur teesra 80% hoga. Successive multiplier laga: $1.2 \times 1.4 \times 1.8 = 1.68 \times 1.8 = 3.024$. Match kar gaya! Pehla option hi hit ho gaya, smart work chahiye yahan par!

questions.q: In an election between P, R and S, $\frac{1}{10}$ of the total votes polled are invalid. Votes polled in favour of R and S are half of the total votes polled, and they get equal votes. Due to a fault in the machine, half of the votes of S and half of the invalid votes are counted additionally in favour of R. What is the overall percentage of votes secured by R due to the fault?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Total votes 100 maan. Invalid ho gaye 10, toh Valid bache 90. R aur S ko milakar adhe votes mile (yani 50), aur dono ko barabar mile yani R = 25, S = 25. Ab fault hua: S ke aadhe vote (12.5) aur Invalid ke aadhe (5) galti se R ko mil gaye. R ki jholi me kitne aaye total? Pehle ke 25 + naye 17.5 = 42.5. 100 ke base pe ye seedha 42.5% ban gaya. Language samajh gaya toh CGL nikal jayega!

questions.q: In an election, only two candidates participated. 80% of people cast their votes and 900 people did not cast their votes. 25% of the votes are declared invalid. If the winner won by 300 valid votes, then find the total number of voters?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, faltu details se dara raha hai examiner. Total logo ka 80% ne vote daala aur jo bache 20% the (jinho ne nahi daala) unki value directly 900 de rakhi hai. Agar 20% = 900 hai, toh Total 100% nikalne ke liye 5 se multiply kar do: $900 \times 5 = 4500$. Baaki ki ramayan (invalid, winner margin) padhne ki jarurat hi nahi thi! Aankh khuli rakhna exam me.

questions.q: In a workshop, the ratio of skilled to unskilled workers is 5: 4. After a hiring drive, the number of skilled workers increased by 10%, while the number of unskilled workers increased by 25%. What is the new ratio of skilled to unskilled workers?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ratio ko 500 aur 400 maan le aasan calculation ke liye. Skilled me 10% increase hua $\implies 500$ ban gaya 550. Unskilled me 25% increase hua $\implies 400$ ka 25% (yani $\frac{1}{4}$) 100 hoga, toh 400 ban gaya 500. Naya ratio $550 : 500$ hai. Zero kaat aur 5 se divide kar, aayega $11 : 10$. Bilkul pen free approach!

questions.q: A right circular cylinder's height increases by 96% while its radius decreases by 25%. What is the approximate percentage change in its volume?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Cylinder ki Volume hamesha $r^2 h$ pe chalti hai. Height (h) almost double (1.96 times) ho gayi. Radius (r) 25% ghat kar 0.75 ($\frac{3}{4}$) reh gayi. R ka square karna zaroori hai! $\frac{3}{4} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{9}{16} = 0.5625$. Ab net effect dekho: $0.5625 \times 1.96 = 1.1025$. Pehle volume 1 tha ab 1.1025 ho gaya. Kitna badha? 10.25% badh gaya. Nearest option approx 10% increase hai, tick mark aur aage badh!

questions.q: An employee contributes 20% of their salary to charity. From the remaining amount, 40% is allocated to investments. The rest is divided for education and travel in the ratio 7:5. If the expense on travel is 6,000, what is the employee's total salary?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, line by line chalte hain. Total 100% hai. 20% charity gayi, bachi 80%. Is 80% ka 40% (yani 32%) investment pe gaya. Bacha kitna? $80 - 32 = 48\%$. Ab is 48% ko Education aur Travel me 7:5 me baantna hai. Ratio ka sum 12 unit hai. Agar 12 unit = 48% hai, toh Travel ka hissa (5 unit) = 20% banega. Ye 20% ki value sawal me 6,000 de rakhi hai. Agar 20% = 6,000 hai, toh 100% total salary 5 guna yani 30,000 hogi! Logic strong ho toh numbers naachte hain.

questions.q: A fruit seller had total (X+50) mangoes and apples. He sold 20% mangoes to A, 40% of remaining to B and had 48 mangoes left. Similarly, he sold 40% apples to A, 100 apples to B and had 10% apples left. Find (X+500).
questions.s: Dekh bhai, tukdo me tod de question ko. Mangoes ke liye successive lagega: $M \times 0.8 \times 0.6 = 48 \implies 0.48M = 48 \implies M = 100$ mangoes initially the. Apples me line method socho: pehle 40% gaye, bache 60%. Ab isme se 100 aur beche, toh end me 10% bache. Equation bani: $0.6A - 100 = 0.1A \implies 0.5A = 100 \implies A = 200$. Total fruits (X+50) = 100 + 200 = 300. Yahan se X aaya 250. Pucha hai X+500 yani $250 + 500 = 750$. Solid approach rakho!
